structure.text: Transport to the port of entry
Means of transport to port of entry

To identify the means of transport, enter (one of the following): flight number / train number / road vehicle registration number / vessel name (for ferries, also the road vehicle registration number)
Are any road trailers or shipping containers being used to transport the consignment?
Container or trailer number / Seal number / Official seal (section heading) / official-seal-1 (checkbox label) / Add another container or trailer — revealed when Yes selected
structure.govukComponent: Text inputs + checkbox + add-another button in custom containers-grid

structure.text: Enter the reference number on the air waybill, bill of lading, sea waybill, road consignment note (CMR) or other transport document.
Estimated arrival at port of entry
Day / Month / Year (hint: For example, 27 3 2023) + Choose date calendar button

Enter the time using 24 hour format, for example, 14 50. If you are unsure of the exact time: Avoid using times on the hour, for example, 00 00 / For non-GVMS route, update the time when you know the time of arrival.

govukComponents.usage: H1 'Transport to the port of entry' (xl); H2 section headings 'Means of transport to port of entry', 'Estimated arrival at port of entry' (m)

Hint text under identification, road-trailers, container/seal/official-seal, document, date and time
Groups the road-trailers/containers Yes/No radios; legend doubles as an H2
Are any road trailers or shipping containers being used? Yes reveals the containers grid (conditional)
Conditional checkbox with rendered label 'official-seal-1' inside the 'Official seal' section of the containers grid
Estimated arrival Day/Month/Year (augmented with a custom datepicker calendar)
Save and return to hub; Save and continue
Validation error summary 'Please fix the following errors' linking to #arrival-date

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Progressive-enhancement of the Port of entry <select> (id=bcp-select, name=bcp) into a type-ahead combobox. A visible text input (id=bcp, no name attribute) is layered over the native select; selecting an option writes the value back to the select.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Third-party library (alphagov/accessible-autocomplete), not core govuk-frontend. Introduces a text input + select value-sync and its own ARIA live status region.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: govuk-frontend has no first-party autocomplete; accessible-autocomplete is the GDS-recommended companion. The new app can source the port list from a reference-data service and keep using accessible-autocomplete, or render a plain Select if the BCP list stays short.
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 92 (bcp text input + bcp-select select; autocomplete__* classes)

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: defra-datepicker / date-picker__dialog / date-picker__date-table / date-picker__button__* / date-picker__reveal__icon (+ 'Choose date' button)
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: A bespoke calendar-picker overlay bolted onto the standard govuk-date-input Day/Month/Year fields. The 'Choose date' button opens a dialog calendar that writes back to the three text inputs.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Custom DEFRA widget, not part of govuk-frontend. Extra JS, a dialog with prev/next-month navigation and its own date-picker-day/month/year hidden inputs. Adds complexity and a11y surface beyond the standard three-field date input.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Standard GOV.UK Date input (three text fields, no calendar) is the toolbox pattern. The new app should prefer the plain Date input unless a calendar is an explicit requirement.
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 92 (defra-datepicker + date-picker__* classes; 'Choose date' button e111)

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: containers-grid / heading-with-help / link-button / sr-only / aria-live-message / hidden
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: containers-grid is a custom layout wrapper for the conditional container-number / seal-number / official-seal fields. link-button styles a button as a link. sr-only / aria-live-message / hidden are custom screen-reader and visibility utilities. heading-with-help wraps a heading with adjacent help.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Bespoke IPAFFS utility/layout classes duplicating things govuk-frontend already provides (govuk-visually-hidden for sr-only; govuk-grid-* for containers-grid; govuk-!-* spacing). Custom CSS to maintain.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: govuk-visually-hidden replaces sr-only; govuk-grid-row/column replaces containers-grid; a govuk-button--secondary or a real link replaces link-button.

fields.label: Port of entry
fields.requiredEvidence: Mandatory for CHED-P submission in the authorised legacy model: PartOne's class-level PortOfEntryAndPointOfEntryNotEmpty constraint applies NotificationCvedpEuFieldValidation and resolves to 'Add the port of entry' (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/PartOne.java:138-141; ipaffs-notification-microservice/service/src/main/resources/ValidationMessages.properties:38). This is legacy submission mandatoriness 'as the old system had it'; the frontend page Joi schema still allows an empty draft value (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/transport_before_bip.js:39-41).
fields.requiredNote: Required by downstream CHED-P model validation at submission, not by an HTML required attribute or the draft-save page validator.
fields.conditionalOn: Available options depend on country of origin: EU origins receive real and dummy POEs except GBSCOT; Northern Ireland receives real and all dummy POEs including GBSCOT; non-EU/ROW origins such as Angola receive real POEs only.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 92; 34 options in that rendered journey (BCP reference data — new app should source from a reference-data service, not hardcode). Full rendered list also includes PETERHEAD (GBPHD), PLYMOUTH (GBPLY), POOLE (GBPPO), PORTSMOUTH - INTERNATIONAL PORT (GBPMEI), PURFLEET (GBPFT), SCRABSTER (GBSCR), SOUTHAMPTON (GBSOU), STANSTED (GBSTN), TEESPORT (GBTEE), THAMESPORT (GBTHP), TILBURY (GBTIL), TILBURY 2 RO-RO TERMINAL (GBTILR), TYNE - NORTH SHIELDS (GBTYNN). QA page object identifies the accessible combobox and underlying select option reader: page-objects/notification/TransportDetailsPage.ts:8-10,101-116. Default TILBURY value: workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:65-66,171-172. The origin-dependent real/dummy option rules are asserted at tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-poe-validation.spec.ts:11-31,54-82. HOLYHEAD availability for EU CHED-P is asserted at tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-holyhead.spec.ts:28-38. GBMAN persistence is asserted at tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-manipulation.spec.ts:55-69.

fields.label: Are any road trailers or shipping containers being used to transport the consignment?
fields.hint: Provide details of all road trailers and containers or your consignment may be delayed. You may need to contact your haulier for this.
fields.requiredEvidence: Not independently mandatory in the legacy page validator: consignment-in-container is an optional boolean and may be empty for CVEDP (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/transport_before_bip.js:102-108). PartOne.sealsContainers is not @NotNull (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/PartOne.java:607-608). The handler interprets only the submitted value 'true' as selecting the conditional branch (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/transport_before_bip.js:146-150).

fields.name: container-number-1
fields.label: Container or trailer number
fields.hint: Enter the container identification number, or the trailer registration number or number plate.
fields.requiredEvidence: Conditionally mandatory when the Yes branch creates a container/trailer row. The frontend CVEDP schema applies a non-empty string rule with a 32-character maximum to each container-number-* value when consignment-in-container is true (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_details.js:161-170; reused by transport_before_bip.js:66-73,102-111). The model also marks NotificationSealsContainers.containerNumber @NotBlank for NotificationCvedpEuFieldValidation with 'Enter container or road trailer number' (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/NotificationSealsContainers.java:50-56).
fields.requiredNote: required:true is conditional on the user selecting Yes and a row being present; no container value is required when the No branch is selected.
